title: Kio: Lantern Tide
summary: Help Kio gather glowing lantern shells before the tide comes in.
description: An original Tuikio game. Kio the hermit crab scuttles across a night beach collecting lantern shells while the sea rises row by row and gulls patrol the sand. Gather every lantern, then hurry home. Each tide is faster than the last; your best score is saved on your phone.

verification.notes: End-to-end host test drives title, movement, pause and quit through the Tuikio runtime.
